notes: Step images are very dark and low-resolution. The edges give the pairs of pieces that connect (one edge per pair), and most ports are left null. Stud and anti-stud positions are not enumerated.

Base layout (my reading): two 4x10 plates side by side make an 8x10 base. The four 1x8 tiles form a ring on its edge, with the printed tile at the front. The two grey 4x6 plates fill the inside, and the four grey 1x6 tiles form a frame on top of them.

Which jumper sits on which stud, and the exact split of the tower courses across the footprint, are inferred. Course 1 is 1x3 + 2x3 + 1x3 (4x3 footprint). The following courses overlap so they interlock.

Round-plate cylinder: each 1x1 round plate (6141) is pushed into the axle hole of the next round plate from below (step 9 and 10 insets). I modelled it as a revolute insert into that plate's axle hole, with its bottom sitting in the lower plate's axle hole. Consecutive round plates are also given contact edges. The round tile 4150 sits on the top round plate.

Step 18 sub-assembly is ambiguous in the pictures. I chained it as white 1x3 plate on the top 1x3 brick, then the two black 1x3 plates, then the 1x1 plate with the 1x1 tile and the two antennas on the top black plate. The step 1 picture may show the white plate on top of a black plate, which is not what I modelled.
